_comments: LAPSED CLOSE DATE DIGEST. The agent record whose DriverClass resolves to the class registered as
exactly: a mismatch does not fail at push time, it fails when the agent first runs.
TypeID is Loop only because an agent needs a type; the class does its work in code and runs one
iteration (MaxIterationsPerRun 1), with no prompt and no model call.
Who receives a digest is the host's data (Deal Digest Recipients), never seeded here. The sender,
provider and link base are Application Settings that ship blank; see application-settings/.

fields.Name: Sales — Lapsed Close Date Digest
fields.Description: Emails each configured recipient the deals whose expected close date has lapsed, scoped by that recipient's audience type. Runs from a scheduled job; pass {"dryRun": true} as the job's StartingPayload to compose without sending.
